e.title: Morai
e.summary: 精算经验仪表盘与预测器（6★，2026-08 活跃）：死亡率/经验数据 A/E 分析 + Claude Code 技能
e.body:
Morai（jkoestner/morai，6★，2026-08 活跃）是精算经验（experience）仪表盘与预测器：分析死亡率与经验数据——可视化仪表盘 + 模型预测，内置项目级 Claude Code skills（model-review：对任何拟合死亡率模型做 A/E 审查，支持 GLM/GAM/CatBoost/神经网络）。对 RIAA：经验分析 + AI 技能融合的新工具——A/E（actual/expected）分析与 [[actxps]]/[[expstudy]]（R 经验研究）互补；Claude skill 路线与 [[ifrs-skill]]/[[actuarial-skills]] 同类；死亡率经验分析配 [[mortality-dynamics]]/[[actstatr]]。

## 同类工具

e.body_en:
Morai (jkoestner/morai, 6★, active 2026-08) is an actuarial experience dashboard and predictor: it analyses mortality and experience data — a visualisation dashboard plus model prediction, with project-scoped Claude Code skills (model-review: A/E review of any fitted mortality model, GLM/GAM/CatBoost/Neural). For RIAA: a tool fusing experience analysis with AI skills — A/E (actual/expected) analysis complements [[actxps]]/[[expstudy]] (R experience studies); the Claude-skill route is the same family as [[ifrs-skill]]/[[actuarial-skills]]; mortality-experience analysis pairs with [[mortality-dynamics]]/[[actstatr]].

## Similar tools
[[nlp-js]]、[[nonlife-pricing-agent]]、[[fortran-from-r-packages]]、[[insurance-ebm]]
